text:
Source-assisted reading of F-ne56 (Antwerpen, Erfgoedbibliotheek Hendrik Conscience, Fragm. 127). Made with the candidate text in view; every line of both faces was reread on enlargements of the native images by a research reader. Square brackets mark what is cut away; round brackets resolve abbreviations; a question mark marks a doubtful reading. Nothing inside square brackets was read.
